name: Gerenzo's Orders
summary: Piznik sends Gerenzo's Orders ore sample to Ziz Fizziks, his contact beyond the dig site. The delivery closes a dangerous act of espionage inside the Venture Company workings at Windshear Crag.

sections.title: A Ticket Out
sections.body: Piznik's cover at Windshear Crag is blown, and he knows he cannot stay with the Venture Company crew. Management in Undermine punishes sabotage within its ranks, so the nervous goblin arranges to slip away and find another employer. Before he goes, he gives an outsider the Unidentified Ore mined under Gerenzo's orders. The specimen must reach its destination without drawing suspicion to Piznik.

sections.title: Corporate Curiosities
sections.body: Ziz Fizziks waits at a secret outpost on the western rim of Windshear Crag. He sees value in the mineral and plans to send it south to Undermine engineers, while quietly keeping a valuable portion for himself. His plan reflects the fierce trade and engineering disputes simmering beneath the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Piznik need to flee Windshear Crag?
faq.answer: Piznik's cover was blown when the site's overseers caught him secretly mining an ore sample for Ziz. He fears swift retribution when the Venture Company's higher-ups learn of it, so he needs to slip away and find new employment.
Ziz Fizziks is a goblin operator camped on Windshear Crag's western ridge. He placed Piznik inside the Venture Company to steal corporate intelligence and rare mineral samples.

The Unidentified Ore is a sample of the mysterious gold-green ore Chief Engineer Gerenzo ordered mined in large amounts. Ziz plans to send it to Undermine engineers and researchers to study its industrial uses.

faq.q: Where can Ziz Fizziks be found?
aliases: where to turn in gerenzo orders
faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks is at a small encampment on the western edge overlooking Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What happens to the ore once Ziz receives it?
aliases: what does ziz do with the ore
faq.answer: Ziz plans to send most of the ore sample to Undermine engineers, while secretly keeping a small shard for himself.

faq.q: Is Piznik loyal to the Venture Company?
faq.answer: Piznik worked for the Venture Company only to serve Ziz's interests. He has no loyalty to the syndicate and fears retribution from its leadership.

angles.text: The Unidentified Ore mined under Gerenzo's orders shows that the Venture Company's work in Windshear Crag reaches beyond deforestation: it also searches the mountains for unknown subterranean wealth.
Goblin engineers in Undermine pay well for unrefined exotic ores that can power volatile new mechanisms and prototypes.
